literal_meaning: শিবের অভাবে যজ্ঞ (a yajna or ritual sacrifice without Shiva)
figurative_meaning_en: A ceremony or ritual excluding the principal figure
similar_in_english: a play without the lead actor
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সম্মেলনটি শিবহীন যজ্ঞের মতো হয়ে দাঁড়িয়েছে, কারণ প্রধান বক্তা অনুপস্থিত।
তার অবস্থা শিবহীন যজ্ঞের মতো, মূল উদ্যোগী ছাড়া সবকিছু অসম্পূর্ণ।
example_sentences_in_english: This conference turned into a Shivahina Yajna because the keynote speaker was absent.
His situation is like a Shivahina Yajna, incomplete without the main initiator.
history: Derived from Hindu Vedic traditions where yajna rituals require the presence of deities like Shiva for completeness and efficacy.
note: The idiom draws from ancient Hindu sacrificial rites, emphasizing the essential role of the divine or central element.
